explanation: Fernando Meirelles and Kátia Lund cast many young residents of Rio's favelas, most of whom had never acted before. The film earned four Oscar nominations, including Best Director.

claims.text: City of God (2002) follows Rocket, a boy from the Cidade de Deus housing project in Rio de Janeiro, who becomes a photographer.
Central Station, Elite Squad and Black Orpheus are Brazilian films that do not follow a boy who becomes a photographer.
City of God was directed by Fernando Meirelles, with Kátia Lund as co-director.
Much of the cast of City of God were young people from Rio's favelas with no acting experience.
City of God received four Academy Award nominations, including Best Director.
